<script>
// Greedy mesher for flat-color minimap voxels.
// occ: Uint32Array [fl*800*800 + z*800 + x], value = packed 0xRRGGBB + 1 (0 = air)
// Greedy mesher for flat-color minimap voxels.
// occ: Uint32Array [fl*800*800 + z*800 + x], value = packed 0xRRGGBB + 1 (0 = air)
function meshColorWorld(occ, X, Y, Z, capFl) {
  if (capFl === undefined) capFl = Y - 1;
  const get = (x, y, z) =>
    (x < 0 || y < 0 || z < 0 || x >= X || y > capFl || y >= Y || z >= Z) ? 0
    : occ[y * X * Z + z * X + x];

  const positions = [], colors = [], indices = [], tops = [];
  let v = 0;
  const dimsArr = [X, Y, Z];
  // Directional face shading: opposite faces get lit vs shadowed values so raised
  // structures read as 3D (a lit side + a shadow side), like the in-game minimap.
  const TINT_TOP = 1.0, TINT_BOTTOM = 0.4;
  const TINT_XP = 0.86, TINT_XN = 0.60;   // +X lit / -X shadowed
  const TINT_ZP = 0.78, TINT_ZN = 0.52;   // +Z lit / -Z shadowed

  for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++) {
    const u = (d + 1) % 3, w = (d + 2) % 3;
    const Du = dimsArr[u], Dw = dimsArr[w], Dd = dimsArr[d];
    const mask = new Float64Array(Du * Dw); // holds signed (packed+1)
    const pos = [0, 0, 0];

    for (let slice = 0; slice <= Dd; slice++) {
      let n = 0;
      for (let j = 0; j < Dw; j++) {
        for (let i = 0; i < Du; i++) {
          pos[d] = slice - 1; pos[u] = i; pos[w] = j;
          const a = get(pos[0], pos[1], pos[2]);
          pos[d] = slice;
          const b = get(pos[0], pos[1], pos[2]);
          let m = 0;
          if (a > 0 && b === 0) m = a;
          else if (b > 0 && a === 0) m = -b;
          mask[j * Du + i] = m;
          if (m) n++;
        }
      }
      if (!n) continue;

      for (let j = 0; j < Dw; j++) {
        for (let i = 0; i < Du;) {
          const m = mask[j * Du + i];
          if (!m) { i++; continue; }
          let wd = 1;
          while (i + wd < Du && mask[j * Du + i + wd] === m) wd++;
          let ht = 1;
          outer: while (j + ht < Dw) {
            for (let k = 0; k < wd; k++)
              if (mask[(j + ht) * Du + i + k] !== m) break outer;
            ht++;
          }
          const packed = Math.abs(m) - 1;
          const back = m < 0;
          let tint, top = 0;
          if (d === 1) { tint = back ? TINT_BOTTOM : TINT_TOP; top = back ? 0 : 1; }
          else if (d === 0) tint = back ? TINT_XN : TINT_XP;
          else tint = back ? TINT_ZN : TINT_ZP;
          const r = Math.pow(((packed >> 16) & 255) / 255, 2.2) * tint;
          const g = Math.pow(((packed >> 8) & 255) / 255, 2.2) * tint;
          const b = Math.pow((packed & 255) / 255, 2.2) * tint;

          const p = [0, 0, 0];
          p[d] = slice; p[u] = i; p[w] = j;
          const du = [0, 0, 0]; du[u] = wd;
          const dw = [0, 0, 0]; dw[w] = ht;
          const quad = [
            [p[0], p[1], p[2]],
            [p[0] + du[0], p[1] + du[1], p[2] + du[2]],
            [p[0] + dw[0], p[1] + dw[1], p[2] + dw[2]],
            [p[0] + du[0] + dw[0], p[1] + du[1] + dw[1], p[2] + du[2] + dw[2]],
          ];
          for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            positions.push(quad[k][0], quad[k][1], quad[k][2]);
            colors.push(r, g, b);
            tops.push(top);
          }
          if (back) indices.push(v, v + 2, v + 1, v + 1, v + 2, v + 3);
          else      indices.push(v, v + 1, v + 2, v + 1, v + 3, v + 2);
          v += 4;

          for (let jj = 0; jj < ht; jj++)
            for (let ii = 0; ii < wd; ii++)
              mask[(j + jj) * Du + i + ii] = 0;
          i += wd;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return {
    positions: new Float32Array(positions),
    colors: new Float32Array(colors),
    indices: new Uint32Array(indices),
    tops: new Float32Array(tops),
    quadCount: v / 4,
  };
}

const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
function loadImg(src){return new Promise(r=>{const i=new Image();i.onload=()=>r(i);i.src=src;});}
function px(img){const c=document.createElement("canvas");c.width=img.width;c.height=img.height;
  const g=c.getContext("2d");g.drawImage(img,0,0);return g.getImageData(0,0,img.width,img.height).data;}

let occ, renderer, scene, camera, mesh=null;
// First-person camera: `target` is the CAMERA position; theta=yaw, pitch=look
// elevation. The camera rotates in place (looks around) rather than orbiting a
// central point. Defaults reproduce the old opening framing.
let theta=2.356194, pitch=-0.7;
const target=new THREE.Vector3(779,460,21);
let cap=31, elev=2.0;
let beacon=null;
function viewDir(){ const cp=Math.cos(pitch); return new THREE.Vector3(cp*Math.cos(theta),Math.sin(pitch),cp*Math.sin(theta)); }
function aimAt(px,py,pz){ const dx=px-target.x,dy=py-target.y,dz=pz-target.z; theta=Math.atan2(dz,dx); pitch=Math.atan2(dy,Math.hypot(dx,dz)); }

// Terrain material: vertex-coloured voxels + a per-cell grid drawn on top faces
// (world-space, so it survives the greedy mesher's merged quads) that fades with
// distance to avoid shimmer — echoing the game minimap's tile grid.
function makeTerrainMaterial(){
  const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({vertexColors:true});
  mat.onBeforeCompile = (sh)=>{
    sh.vertexShader = 'attribute float aTop;\nvarying float vTop;\nvarying vec3 vWPos;\n' +
      sh.vertexShader.replace('#include <begin_vertex>',
        '#include <begin_vertex>\n  vTop = aTop;\n  vWPos = (modelMatrix * vec4(transformed, 1.0)).xyz;');
    sh.fragmentShader = 'varying float vTop;\nvarying vec3 vWPos;\n' +
      sh.fragmentShader.replace('#include <dithering_fragment>',
        'vec2 gcell = abs(fract(vWPos.xz) - 0.5);\n' +
        'float gedge = max(gcell.x, gcell.y);\n' +
        'float gdist = length(vWPos - cameraPosition);\n' +
        'float gfade = 1.0 - smoothstep(420.0, 1150.0, gdist);\n' +
        'float gline = smoothstep(0.4, 0.5, gedge) * vTop * gfade;\n' +
        'gl_FragColor.rgb *= mix(1.0, 0.6, gline);\n' +
        '#include <dithering_fragment>');
  };
  return mat;
}
function buildMesh(){
  const m = meshColorWorld(occ, X, Y, Z, cap);
  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(m.positions,3));
  geo.setAttribute("color", new THREE.BufferAttribute(m.colors,3));
  geo.setAttribute("aTop", new THREE.BufferAttribute(m.tops,1));
  geo.setIndex(new THREE.BufferAttribute(m.indices,1));
  if(mesh){ mesh.geometry.dispose(); mesh.geometry = geo; }
  else{
    mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, makeTerrainMaterial());
    mesh.frustumCulled = false;
    scene.add(mesh);
  }
  mesh.scale.set(1, elev, 1);
}

async function init(){
  occ = new Uint32Array(X*Y*Z);
  for(let fl=0; fl<Y; fl++){
    const img = await loadImg("data:image/png;base64,"+FLOOR_B64[fl]);
    const d = px(img);
    const base = fl*X*Z;
    for(let i=0;i<X*Z;i++){
      if(d[i*4+3]===255)
        occ[base+i] = ((d[i*4]<<16)|(d[i*4+1]<<8)|d[i*4+2])+1;
    }
  }
  renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas:$("scene"),antialias:true});
  renderer.setPixelRatio(pixelCap());
  renderer.outputEncoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding;
  scene = new THREE.Scene();
  scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0b0e14);
  scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x0b0e14, 1100, 2600);
  camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(55, innerWidth/innerHeight, 0.5, 6000);
  buildMesh();
  applyGoto();
  $("loading").remove();
  onResize(); animate();
}

function recarve(){
  $("busy").style.display="block";
  setTimeout(()=>{ buildMesh(); $("busy").style.display="none"; }, 20);
}

function camUpdate(){
  // first-person: camera sits AT target and looks along yaw+pitch. Clamp pitch
  // shy of straight up/down so the view can't flip.
  pitch=Math.min(Math.max(pitch,-1.45),1.45);
  const d=viewDir();
  camera.position.copy(target);
  camera.lookAt(target.x+d.x, target.y+d.y, target.z+d.z);
}

function moveWASD(){
  const now=performance.now(); const dt=Math.min((now-lastT)/1000,0.1); lastT=now;
  // fixed base fly speed × user move-speed setting × shift boost — no longer tied to zoom distance
  const sp=(keys[bind.boost]?2.2:1.0)*260*dt*moveSpeed;
  const fwd=new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(theta),0,Math.sin(theta));
  const right=new THREE.Vector3(-fwd.z,0,fwd.x);
  if(keys[bind.forward]) target.addScaledVector(fwd, sp);
  if(keys[bind.back])    target.addScaledVector(fwd,-sp);
  if(keys[bind.left])    target.addScaledVector(right,-sp);
  if(keys[bind.right])   target.addScaledVector(right, sp);
  if(keys[bind.down])    target.y-=sp;
  if(keys[bind.up])      target.y+=sp;
}

  renderer.render(scene,camera);}

/* Render resolution. Phones ship 3x displays, and rendering this many voxels at
   3x (or even the old 2x cap) is a lot of fill for a mobile GPU; 1.5x is hard to
   tell apart here and much cheaper. Desktop keeps the original 2x cap. */
