/* ---- deep-link marker (from the wiki "See on the map" button) ---- */
// topmost solid floor at a column, at or below a given floor cap
function surfaceFloorAt(vx,vz,capF){
  const x=Math.round(vx), z=Math.round(vz);
  if(x<0||x>=X||z<0||z>=Z) return 0;
  const topFl=Math.min(capF, Y-1);
  for(let y=topFl; y>=0; y--){ if(occ[y*X*Z + z*X + x]) return y; }
  return 0;
}
// Offset between the game's NPC coordinates and this decoded minimap, fitted so
// 207/208 NPCs land on walkable tiles: voxelX = 400+gx+8, voxelZ = 400-gz-9,
// floor = level + 16.
const GX_OFF=8, GZ_OFF=-9, LVL_OFF=16;
let beaconTile=null;
const _markers=[];
function clearMarker(){ for(const m of _markers) scene.remove(m); _markers.length=0; beacon=null; beaconTile=null; }
function mkMarker(geo,op){ const m=new THREE.Mesh(geo,new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xf0a53c,transparent:true,opacity:op,depthTest:false,side:THREE.DoubleSide})); m.frustumCulled=false; m.renderOrder=999; scene.add(m); _markers.push(m); return m; }
// Fly to an in-game coordinate: slice to the NPC's floor if it's buried, then
// highlight the exact tile it stands on with a pin + a glowing cell.
function flyToGame(gx,gz,lvl){
  clearMarker();
  const vxi=Math.round(X/2 + gx + GX_OFF), vzi=Math.round(Z/2 - gz + GZ_OFF);
  const cx=vxi+0.5, cz=vzi+0.5;                        // centre of the voxel cell
  const npcFloor=Math.max(0, Math.min(Y-1, Math.round(lvl||0) + LVL_OFF));
  if(surfaceFloorAt(vxi,vzi,Y-1) > npcFloor + 1){       // buried -> slice down to reveal it
    cap=npcFloor;
    const cs=$("cap"); if(cs) cs.value=cap;
    const cv=$("capv"); if(cv) cv.textContent=cap;
    buildMesh();
  }
  const sy=(surfaceFloorAt(vxi,vzi,cap)+1)*elev;
  // highlight the exact tile — a glowing 1x1 cell + crisp outline on the surface
  const tile=mkMarker(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,0.5,1),0.55); tile.position.set(cx, sy+0.28, cz); tile.userData.baseOp=0.55; beaconTile=tile;
  const outline=new THREE.LineSegments(new THREE.EdgesGeometry(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.02,0.54,1.02)), new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:0xfff0c0,transparent:true,opacity:0.95,depthTest:false}));
  outline.position.set(cx, sy+0.28, cz); outline.frustumCulled=false; outline.renderOrder=999; scene.add(outline); _markers.push(outline);
  // downward pin whose tip points at the tile
  const pinH=20;
  const pin=mkMarker(new THREE.ConeGeometry(5,pinH,18),0.95); pin.rotation.x=Math.PI;
  pin.position.set(cx, sy+7+pinH/2, cz); pin.userData.baseY=pin.position.y; beacon=pin;
  // thin tall beam so the spot is findable from far away
  const beam=mkMarker(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.2,1.2,150,8),0.45); beam.position.set(cx, sy+pinH+85, cz);
  // frame the spot: hover just up and to the SE, looking down at the tile
  target.set(cx+62, sy+100, cz+62); aimAt(cx, sy+4, cz);
}
function applyGoto(){
  let q; try{ q=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("goto"); }catch(e){ q=null; }
  if(!q)return;
  const pp=q.split(",").map(Number); if(pp.length<2||isNaN(pp[0])||isNaN(pp[1]))return;
  flyToGame(pp[0], pp[1], (pp.length>2&&!isNaN(pp[2]))?pp[2]:0);
}
/* ---- NPC finder ---- */
(function(){
  const inp=$("npcFind"), box=$("npcResults");
  if(!inp||!box) return;
  let sel=-1, shown=[];
  function render(q){
    q=q.trim().toLowerCase();
    if(!q){ box.classList.remove("open"); box.innerHTML=""; shown=[]; sel=-1; return; }
    shown=NPC_INDEX.filter(e=>e.n.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>=0).slice(0,50);
    sel=-1;
    if(!shown.length){ box.innerHTML='<div class="npc-res empty">No NPC found</div>'; box.classList.add("open"); return; }
    box.innerHTML=shown.map((e,i)=>'<div class="npc-res" data-i="'+i+'">'+e.n.replace(/[&<>]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;'}[c]))+'<span class="rl">'+e.x+', '+e.z+'</span></div>').join("");
    box.classList.add("open");
  }
  function go(i){ const e=shown[i]; if(!e) return; if(window.__onFindPick) window.__onFindPick(e); flyToGame(e.x,e.z,e.l); box.classList.remove("open"); inp.value=e.n; inp.blur(); }
  inp.addEventListener("input",()=>render(inp.value));
  inp.addEventListener("focus",()=>{ if(inp.value) render(inp.value); });
  inp.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
    if(!box.classList.contains("open")) return;
    if(e.key==="ArrowDown"){ e.preventDefault(); sel=Math.min(shown.length-1,sel+1); }
    else if(e.key==="ArrowUp"){ e.preventDefault(); sel=Math.max(0,sel-1); }
    else if(e.key==="Enter"){ e.preventDefault(); go(sel<0?0:sel); return; }
    else if(e.key==="Escape"){ box.classList.remove("open"); inp.blur(); return; }
    else return;
    box.querySelectorAll(".npc-res").forEach((el,i)=>el.classList.toggle("sel",i===sel));
    const s2=box.querySelector(".npc-res.sel"); if(s2) s2.scrollIntoView({block:"nearest"});
  });
  box.addEventListener("click",e=>{ const r=e.target.closest(".npc-res"); if(!r||r.dataset.i===undefined) return; go(parseInt(r.dataset.i,10)); });
  document.addEventListener("click",e=>{ if(!e.target.closest(".npc-find")) box.classList.remove("open"); });
})();
/* ---- touch: settings drawer + thumb flight HUD ----
   Deliberately inside this script's scope so it can reach bind/setKey/keys/drag
   directly. The buttons press the same keys the keyboard would, which means
   moveWASD() is untouched and a user's rebinds still apply on a phone. */
(function(){
  const hud=$("hud"), toggle=$("hudToggle"), scrim=$("hudScrim"), closeBtn=$("hudClose");
  if(!hud||!toggle||!scrim) return;
  const mobile=()=>matchMedia("(max-width:739px)").matches;

  function releaseAll(){
    for(const k in keys) if(keys[k]) setKey(k,false);
    document.querySelectorAll("#touchpad .tp-btn.down").forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("down"));
  }
  /* Open/shut lives on <body> as two explicit classes. The panel's default
     differs by size — visible on desktop, a shut drawer on a phone — so neither
     "hidden unless .open" nor "shown unless .shut" works alone. */
  function setHud(open){
    document.body.classList.toggle("hud-open",open);
    document.body.classList.toggle("hud-shut",!open);
    scrim.classList.toggle("open",open);
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded",open?"true":"false");
    // only the desktop preference is remembered; on a phone the drawer always
    // starts shut so it never covers the map on arrival
    if(!mobile()){ try{ localStorage.setItem("apogea_map_hud",open?"1":"0"); }catch(e){} }
    // otherwise you keep flying blind behind the panel
    if(open) releaseAll();
  }
  function hudIsOpen(){ return document.body.classList.contains("hud-open"); }
  toggle.addEventListener("click",()=>setHud(!hudIsOpen()));
  if(closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener("click",()=>setHud(false));
  scrim.addEventListener("click",()=>setHud(false));
  document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
    if(e.key==="Escape"&&hudIsOpen()&&!listening) setHud(false);
  });

  /* ---- move-pad side (left- or right-handed) ----
     Swapping sides is just flex-direction on #touchpad; the buttons and their
     bindings are untouched. */
  const PAD_KEY="apogea_map_padside";
  const pad=$("touchpad");
  function applyPadSide(side){
    if(pad) pad.classList.toggle("swap",side==="right");
    document.querySelectorAll("#padSideRow .seg-btn").forEach(b=>{
      const on=b.dataset.side===side;
      b.classList.toggle("on",on);
      b.setAttribute("aria-pressed",on?"true":"false");
    });
  }
  let padSide="left";
  try{ const sv=localStorage.getItem(PAD_KEY); if(sv==="left"||sv==="right") padSide=sv; }catch(e){}
  applyPadSide(padSide);
  document.querySelectorAll("#padSideRow .seg-btn").forEach(b=>{
    b.addEventListener("click",()=>{
      padSide=b.dataset.side;
      // a half-pressed direction would stick when the button moves out from
      // under the finger
      releaseAll();
      applyPadSide(padSide);
      try{ localStorage.setItem(PAD_KEY,padSide); }catch(e){}
    });
  });

  /* Initial visibility: remembered on desktop (default shown, as before), always
     shut on a phone. Re-evaluated when crossing the breakpoint so a resize can't
     leave a desktop-sized panel covering a phone-sized map. */
  function initHud(){
    if(mobile()){ setHud(false); return; }
    let open=true;
    try{ open=localStorage.getItem("apogea_map_hud")!=="0"; }catch(e){}
    setHud(open);
  }
  initHud();
  const mq=matchMedia("(max-width:739px)");
  const onMQ=()=>initHud();
  if(mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener("change",onMQ); else mq.addListener(onMQ);

  // --- thumb pad: press -> hold the bound key, release -> let go ---
  document.querySelectorAll('#touchpad .tp-btn[data-act]').forEach(btn=>{
    const act=btn.dataset.act;
    function press(on){
      const k=bind[act];
      if(k) setKey(k,on);
      btn.classList.toggle("down",on);
    }
    btn.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{
      e.preventDefault();
      try{ btn.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); }catch(_){}
      press(true);
    });
    // lostpointercapture covers the finger sliding off the button, which
    // pointerup alone would miss and leave the key stuck down
    ["pointerup","pointercancel","lostpointercapture"].forEach(ev=>
      btn.addEventListener(ev,()=>press(false)));
    btn.addEventListener("contextmenu",e=>e.preventDefault());
  });

  /* Boost latches instead of being held: you cannot hold shift with a thumb and
     steer at the same time. */
  const boostBtn=$("tpBoost");
  if(boostBtn) boostBtn.addEventListener("click",()=>{
    const k=bind.boost; if(!k) return;
    const on=!keys[k];
    setKey(k,on);
    boostBtn.classList.toggle("down",on);
  });

  /* --- two-finger pan + pinch to move along the view direction ---
     One finger still runs the existing look-around path. These listeners are
     registered after that code, and for events on the canvas itself listener
     order is registration order, so clearing `drag` here reliably wins and the
     original handler then early-returns on its own !drag check. */
  const pts=new Map();
  let pinchDist=0, panMid=null;
  function dist(){
    const v=[...pts.values()];
    return Math.hypot(v[0].x-v[1].x, v[0].y-v[1].y);
  }
  function mid(){
    const v=[...pts.values()];
    return {x:(v[0].x+v[1].x)/2, y:(v[0].y+v[1].y)/2};
  }
  cv.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{
    if(e.pointerType!=="touch") return;
    pts.set(e.pointerId,{x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY});
    if(pts.size===2){ drag=null; pinchDist=dist(); panMid=mid(); }
  });
  cv.addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{
    if(e.pointerType!=="touch" || !pts.has(e.pointerId)) return;
    pts.set(e.pointerId,{x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY});
    if(pts.size!==2) return;
    const d=dist(), m=mid();
    // pinch: travel along where you are looking
    target.addScaledVector(viewDir(), (d-pinchDist)*1.7);
    // drag both fingers: slide the camera across the world
    const fwd=new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(theta),0,Math.sin(theta));
    const right=new THREE.Vector3(-fwd.z,0,fwd.x);
    target.addScaledVector(right,-(m.x-panMid.x)*0.9);
    target.addScaledVector(fwd,  -(m.y-panMid.y)*0.9);
    pinchDist=d; panMid=m;
  });
  ["pointerup","pointercancel"].forEach(ev=>cv.addEventListener(ev,e=>{
    if(e.pointerType!=="touch") return;
    pts.delete(e.pointerId);
    if(pts.size<2){ pinchDist=0; panMid=null; }
  }));

  // backgrounding the tab must not leave a key latched on
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",()=>{ if(document.hidden) releaseAll(); });
})();

/* ---- creature & NPC spawns ------------------------------------------------
   All 4,067 spawn records decoded from the world data — 3,838 creatures over 82
   species and 229 NPCs over 210 characters — drawn as their in-game *minimap*
   sprites: the little 8x8 pixel icons the game itself paints on its minimap,
   not the 3D model renders the wiki uses for artwork.

   Creatures and NPCs share every code path here and differ only by a flag
   (M.npc), a toggle each, and which card they open.

   The sprites are billboarded quads INSIDE the three.js scene, not DOM nodes
   over the canvas. That one decision is what makes them behave: the depth
   buffer hides a creature standing behind a hill for free and per-pixel, the
   canvas sits below the Settings panel in the stacking order so nothing floats
   over the UI, and the GPU re-billboards them every frame so they stay welded
   to the terrain while you fly instead of chasing it a few frames behind.

   Three rules shape the rest:

   1. They fade in once a sprite is big enough to read. Size is a fixed world
      length (SPRITE_W), so "readable" is just a distance, and the fade is a
      smoothstep in the vertex shader — creatures dissolve in rather than pop.
   2. Nearby spawns of the same creature collapse into one sprite with a count
      badge. Clustering is done in WORLD space on a power-of-two grid whose
      size comes from the camera distance, so a cluster's position never moves
      while you fly (that was the flicker) and cells still subdivide as you get
      closer.
   3. A creature under rock stays hidden until you slice down to it, via the
      same surfaceFloorAt() column test the deep-link beacon uses.

   Picking is done on the CPU — the clusters are projected and hit-tested, then
   a ray is marched through the voxel field to reject anything the terrain is
   covering. That is a handful of rays per click, and it keeps the click target
   in exact agreement with what the depth buffer drew. */
(function(){
  if(typeof SPAWN_META==="undefined" || typeof SPAWN_FLAT==="undefined") return;

  const M=SPAWN_META, F=SPAWN_FLAT, N=F.length/4;
  const sN=new Uint8Array(N);                        // creature index into M.names
  const vX=new Int16Array(N), vZ=new Int16Array(N);  // voxel-grid cell
  const vF=new Uint8Array(N);                        // floor 0..31
  const gX=new Int16Array(N), gZ=new Int16Array(N), gL=new Int8Array(N);  // game coords
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
    const o=i*4;
    sN[i]=F[o]; gX[i]=F[o+1]; gZ[i]=F[o+2]; gL[i]=F[o+3];
    // identical transform to flyToGame(), so a spawn and a "see on the map"
    // beacon for the same tile land on the same voxel
    vX[i]=Math.round(X/2 + F[o+1] + GX_OFF);
    vZ[i]=Math.round(Z/2 - F[o+2] + GZ_OFF);
    vF[i]=Math.max(0, Math.min(Y-1, F[o+3] + LVL_OFF));
  }
  const byName=[]; for(let k=0;k<M.names.length;k++) byName.push([]);
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++) byName[sN[i]].push(i);

  // topmost solid floor in each spawn's column at the current slice; only
  // recomputed when the slice moves, since it costs 3,838 column walks
  const surf=new Int16Array(N);
  let surfCap=-1;
  function refreshSurf(){
    if(surfCap===cap) return;
    surfCap=cap;
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++) surf[i]=surfaceFloorAt(vX[i],vZ[i],cap);
  }
  // ground a sprite stands on. max() guards the handful of spawns sitting above
  // their column's solid top (scripted spawns over water/void) — they hover at
  // their own floor instead of dropping to the sea bed.
  function standY(i){ return (Math.max(surf[i], vF[i]-1)+1)*elev + 0.25; }

  const SPRITE_W=5.6;    // world units tall — the sprite's real size
  /* A sprite is drawn at its true world size until that would fall below
     MIN_PX, then it holds at MIN_PX while fading out between MIN_PX and
     FADE_PX. Without the floor a distant creature shrinks to an unreadable
     speck long before it disappears; without the fade it would pop. */
  const MIN_PX=15;
  const FADE_PX=10;
  const MAX_PX=54;       // stops a spawn you fly into filling the screen
  const CLUSTER_PX=26;   // rough on-screen spacing a cluster cell aims for
  const COARSE=32;       // cell-size is decided per COARSE block, see rebuild()
  const MAXQ=1400;       // quad budget; nearest clusters win
  const REBUILD_MS=110;

  let spawnsOn=true, npcOn=true;
  try{ spawnsOn=localStorage.getItem("apogea_map_spawns")!=="0"; }catch(e){}
  try{ npcOn=localStorage.getItem("apogea_map_npcs")!=="0"; }catch(e){}
  const isNpc=k=>!!M.npc[k];
  const kindOn=k=>isNpc(k)?npcOn:spawnsOn;
  let filterIdx=-1;      // -1 = everything its toggle allows

  /* ---------------- textures ---------------- */
  const VERT=[
    "attribute vec2 aCorner;","attribute vec2 aOffset;",
    "attribute float aSize;","attribute float aScale;",
    "varying vec2 vUv;","varying float vFade;",
    "uniform float uKh;","uniform float uMinPx;","uniform float uMaxPx;",
    "uniform float uFadeD;","uniform float uFadeW;",
    "void main(){",
    "  vUv = uv;",
    "  vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);",
    "  float d = max(-mv.z, 0.001);",
    // true world size, floored so it stays readable and capped so a sprite you
    // fly into cannot swallow the screen
    "  float size = clamp(aSize, uMinPx*d/uKh, uMaxPx*d/uKh);",
    "  mv.xy += aOffset*size + aCorner*size*aScale;",
    "  vFade = 1.0 - smoothstep(uFadeD-uFadeW, uFadeD, d);",
    "  gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv;",
    "}"].join("\n");
  const FRAG=[
    "uniform sampler2D map;",
    "varying vec2 vUv;","varying float vFade;",
    "void main(){",
    "  vec4 c = texture2D(map, vUv);",
    "  if(c.a < 0.5 || vFade < 0.02) discard;",
    "  gl_FragColor = vec4(c.rgb, c.a*vFade);",
    "  #include <encodings_fragment>",
    "}"].join("\n");

  function makeMat(tex){
    return new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms:{map:{value:tex},uKh:{value:800},uMinPx:{value:MIN_PX},uMaxPx:{value:MAX_PX},
                uFadeD:{value:300},uFadeW:{value:90}},
      vertexShader:VERT, fragmentShader:FRAG,
      transparent:true, depthTest:true, depthWrite:false
    });
  }
  // The creature atlas is pixel art: nearest magnification keeps it crisp,
  // mipmapped minification stops it fizzing when a sprite is small.
  const creatureTex=new THREE.Texture();
  creatureTex.flipY=false; creatureTex.magFilter=THREE.NearestFilter;
  creatureTex.minFilter=THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;
  (function(){ const im=new Image(); im.onload=()=>{ creatureTex.image=im; creatureTex.needsUpdate=true; }; im.src=M.atlas; })();

  // Count badges are drawn, not pixel art, so they get linear filtering. 2..99
  // plus a "99+" cell; a cluster of exactly 1 draws no badge at all.
  const BADGE_CELL=64, BADGE_COLS=10;
  const badgeTex=(function(){
    const rows=Math.ceil(99/BADGE_COLS);
    const c=document.createElement("canvas");
    c.width=BADGE_COLS*BADGE_CELL; c.height=rows*BADGE_CELL;
    const g=c.getContext("2d");
    g.textAlign="center"; g.textBaseline="middle";
    for(let n=2;n<=100;n++){
      const i=n-2, x=(i%BADGE_COLS)*BADGE_CELL, y=((i/BADGE_COLS)|0)*BADGE_CELL;
      const label=n>99?"99+":String(n);
      // the pill nearly fills its cell: the quad is only ~0.55 of the sprite,
      // so a pill drawn small inside the cell ends up a few pixels wide
      const w=label.length>2?62:(label.length>1?54:42), h=40, r=20;
      const px=x+(BADGE_CELL-w)/2, py=y+(BADGE_CELL-h)/2;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(px+r,py);
      g.arcTo(px+w,py,px+w,py+h,r); g.arcTo(px+w,py+h,px,py+h,r);
      g.arcTo(px,py+h,px,py,r);     g.arcTo(px,py,px+w,py,r);
      g.closePath();
      g.fillStyle="#f0a53c"; g.fill();
      g.lineWidth=4; g.strokeStyle="rgba(0,0,0,.65)"; g.stroke();
      g.fillStyle="#241605";
      g.font="700 "+(label.length>2?24:30)+"px 'Lucida Console',Monaco,monospace";
      g.fillText(label, x+BADGE_CELL/2, y+BADGE_CELL/2+1);
    }
    const t=new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
    t.flipY=false; t.magFilter=THREE.LinearFilter;
    t.minFilter=THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;
    return t;
  })();

  /* ---------------- quad buffers ---------------- */
  function makeQuads(tex){
    const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    const pos=new Float32Array(MAXQ*4*3), cor=new Float32Array(MAXQ*4*2),
          uv=new Float32Array(MAXQ*4*2), sz=new Float32Array(MAXQ*4),
          off=new Float32Array(MAXQ*4*2), sc=new Float32Array(MAXQ*4);
    const idx=new Uint16Array(MAXQ*6);
    const CORNERS=[-0.5,-0.5, 0.5,-0.5, 0.5,0.5, -0.5,0.5];
    for(let q=0;q<MAXQ;q++){
      for(let v=0;v<4;v++){ cor[(q*4+v)*2]=CORNERS[v*2]; cor[(q*4+v)*2+1]=CORNERS[v*2+1]; }
      const b=q*4;
      idx[q*6]=b; idx[q*6+1]=b+1; idx[q*6+2]=b+2;
      idx[q*6+3]=b; idx[q*6+4]=b+2; idx[q*6+5]=b+3;
    }
    g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos,3));
    g.setAttribute("aCorner",  new THREE.BufferAttribute(cor,2));
    g.setAttribute("uv",       new THREE.BufferAttribute(uv,2));
    g.setAttribute("aSize",    new THREE.BufferAttribute(sz,1));
    g.setAttribute("aOffset",  new THREE.BufferAttribute(off,2));
    g.setAttribute("aScale",   new THREE.BufferAttribute(sc,1));
    g.setIndex(new THREE.BufferAttribute(idx,1));
    g.setDrawRange(0,0);
    const m=new THREE.Mesh(g, makeMat(tex));
    m.frustumCulled=false;          // the geometry is rebuilt around the camera
    m.renderOrder=10;               // after the opaque terrain
    return m;
  }
  const spriteMesh=makeQuads(creatureTex), badgeMesh=makeQuads(badgeTex);
  let added=false;

  // write one quad; corner/index data is already baked in
  function putQuad(mesh,q,x,y,z,u0,v0,u1,v1,size,offx,offy,scale){
    const a=mesh.geometry.attributes;
    for(let v=0;v<4;v++){
      const p=(q*4+v);
      a.position.array[p*3]=x; a.position.array[p*3+1]=y; a.position.array[p*3+2]=z;
      a.aSize.array[p]=size; a.aScale.array[p]=scale;
      a.aOffset.array[p*2]=offx; a.aOffset.array[p*2+1]=offy;
    }
    // flipY is off, so v0 is the TOP of the cell
    const U=a.uv.array, b=q*4*2;
    U[b]=u0;   U[b+1]=v1;   // bottom-left
    U[b+2]=u1; U[b+3]=v1;   // bottom-right
    U[b+4]=u1; U[b+5]=v0;   // top-right
    U[b+6]=u0; U[b+7]=v0;   // top-left
  }

  /* ---------------- clustering ---------------- */
  let active=[];             // built clusters, for hit-testing
  const clusters=new Map();
  function khNow(){ return innerHeight*0.5/Math.tan(camera.fov*Math.PI/360); }

  let lastX=1e9,lastY=1e9,lastZ=1e9,lastCap=-1,lastElev=-1,lastFilter=-2,lastKh=-1,lastAt=0;

  function rebuild(){
    lastAt=performance.now();
    const cp=camera.position, kh=khNow();
    lastX=cp.x; lastY=cp.y; lastZ=cp.z; lastCap=cap; lastElev=elev; lastFilter=filterIdx; lastKh=kh;

    const holdD=SPRITE_W*kh/MIN_PX;     // beyond here the sprite stops shrinking
    const fadeD=SPRITE_W*kh/FADE_PX;    // ...and by here it has faded out
    for(const mt of [spriteMesh.material, badgeMesh.material]){
      mt.uniforms.uKh.value=kh;
      mt.uniforms.uFadeD.value=fadeD;
      mt.uniforms.uFadeW.value=fadeD-holdD;
    }

    if(!spawnsOn && !npcOn){ active=[]; spriteMesh.geometry.setDrawRange(0,0); badgeMesh.geometry.setDrawRange(0,0); setHint(0); return; }

    refreshSurf();
    const cull2=fadeD*fadeD;
    clusters.clear();
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
      if(filterIdx>=0 ? sN[i]!==filterIdx : !kindOn(sN[i])) continue;
      if(vF[i]>cap) continue;                      // sliced away
      if(surf[i]>vF[i]+1) continue;                // buried under rock
      const wx=vX[i]+0.5, wz=vZ[i]+0.5, wy=standY(i);
      const dx=wx-cp.x, dy=wy-cp.y, dz=wz-cp.z, d2=dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz;
      if(d2>cull2) continue;
      /* Cell size comes from the distance to the COARSE block this spawn sits
         in, not from the spawn's own distance: every spawn in a block then
         agrees on the size, so a cluster can never be torn in half by two of
         its members rounding to different grids. Powers of two mean the size
         only ever changes at discrete steps, which is what keeps a cluster
         still while you fly past it. */
      const bx=(Math.floor(vX[i]/COARSE)+0.5)*COARSE, bz=(Math.floor(vZ[i]/COARSE)+0.5)*COARSE;
      const bd=Math.sqrt((bx-cp.x)*(bx-cp.x)+dy*dy+(bz-cp.z)*(bz-cp.z));
      let lvl=Math.ceil(Math.log(Math.max(1,CLUSTER_PX*bd/kh))/Math.LN2);
      if(lvl<0) lvl=0; else if(lvl>5) lvl=5;
      const cs=1<<lvl;
      /* Floors are banded rather than exact: uneven ground puts neighbouring
         spawns of one creature on floors that differ by one or two, and keying
         on the exact floor shattered those groups into singletons. A cave sits
         far more than four floors under its surface, so the band still keeps
         them apart. */
      const key=sN[i]+"|"+(vF[i]>>2)+"|"+lvl+"|"+Math.floor(vX[i]/cs)+"|"+Math.floor(vZ[i]/cs);
      let c=clusters.get(key);
      if(!c){ c={n:sN[i],c:0,d2:d2,i:i,x:wx,y:wy,z:wz}; clusters.set(key,c); }
      c.c++;
      if(d2<c.d2) c.d2=d2;
      /* The sprite stands on the LOWEST-INDEXED member, not on the centroid and
         not on whichever member is nearest. Lowest index is the only choice
         that does not depend on the camera, so the sprite cannot creep as you
         fly past — and unlike a centroid it is always a real spawn on real
         ground rather than a point averaged into a wall. */
      if(i<c.i){ c.i=i; c.x=wx; c.y=wy; c.z=wz; }
    }

    let list=[...clusters.values()];
    if(list.length>MAXQ){ list.sort((a,b)=>a.d2-b.d2); list.length=MAXQ; }
    // back-to-front, so overlapping sprites blend in the right order
    list.sort((a,b)=>b.d2-a.d2);

    const cell=M.cell, cols=M.cols, aw=M.aw, ah=M.ah;
    let nb=0;
    for(let q=0;q<list.length;q++){
      const c=list[q];
      const col=c.n%cols, row=(c.n/cols)|0;
      putQuad(spriteMesh,q,c.x,c.y,c.z,
              col*cell/aw, row*cell/ah, (col+1)*cell/aw, (row+1)*cell/ah,
              SPRITE_W, 0, 0.5, 1);
      if(c.c>1){
        const bi=Math.min(c.c,100)-2;
        const bc=bi%BADGE_COLS, br=(bi/BADGE_COLS)|0;
        const bw=BADGE_COLS*BADGE_CELL, bh=badgeTex.image.height;
        putQuad(badgeMesh,nb++,c.x,c.y,c.z,
                bc*BADGE_CELL/bw, br*BADGE_CELL/bh, (bc+1)*BADGE_CELL/bw, (br+1)*BADGE_CELL/bh,
                SPRITE_W, 0.36, 0.17, 0.55);
      }
    }
    for(const a of [spriteMesh.geometry.attributes, badgeMesh.geometry.attributes])
      for(const k in a) a[k].needsUpdate=true;
    spriteMesh.geometry.setDrawRange(0, list.length*6);
    badgeMesh.geometry.setDrawRange(0, nb*6);
    active=list;
    setHint(list.length);
  }

  function tick(){
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    if(!occ || !camera || !scene) return;
    if(!added){ scene.add(spriteMesh); scene.add(badgeMesh); added=true; }
    const cp=camera.position, kh=khNow();
    const moved=Math.abs(cp.x-lastX)+Math.abs(cp.y-lastY)+Math.abs(cp.z-lastZ);
    const forced = cap!==lastCap || elev!==lastElev || filterIdx!==lastFilter || kh!==lastKh;
    /* Only the CLUSTERING depends on where the camera is, and a cluster's
       world position never moves between rebuilds — the GPU re-billboards it
       every frame regardless. So this can idle at ~9Hz while flying without
       any of the sprites lagging behind the terrain. */
    if(forced || (moved>3 && performance.now()-lastAt>REBUILD_MS)) rebuild();
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);

  function setHint(n){
    const h=$("spawnHint");
    if(!h) return;
    if(!spawnsOn && !npcOn){ h.textContent="Both hidden"; h.classList.remove("on"); return; }
    if(!n){
      // with a filter on, "fly closer" is usually the wrong advice — the thing
      // is more often sealed under rock than simply far away
      h.textContent=filterIdx>=0
        ? "None of these in view — fly closer or slice deeper"
        : "Fly closer to see them";
      h.classList.remove("on");
    }
    else{ h.textContent=n+(n===1?" group nearby":" groups nearby"); h.classList.add("on"); }
  }

  /* ---------------- picking ----------------
     The depth buffer decides what is DRAWN, so the click test has to reach the
     same verdict independently. It marches the voxel field between the camera
     and the sprite: one sample per voxel is enough at these distances, it
     early-exits on the first solid cell, and it only ever runs for the one or
     two clusters actually under the cursor. */
  function blocked(ax,ay,az,bx,by,bz){
    const dx=bx-ax, dy=by-ay, dz=bz-az;
    const dist=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz);
    if(dist<3) return false;
    const n=Math.min(600, Math.ceil(dist));
    const sx=dx/n, sy=dy/n/elev, sz=dz/n;     // Y is scaled by elev in world space
    let x=ax, y=ay/elev, z=az;
    for(let i=0;i<n-2;i++){                   // stop short of the creature's own ground
      x+=sx; y+=sy; z+=sz;
      const cx=x|0, cz=z|0, fl=Math.floor(y);
      if(cx<0||cx>=X||cz<0||cz>=Z||fl<0||fl>Y-1||fl>cap) continue;
      if(occ[fl*X*Z + cz*X + cx]) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  const _v=new THREE.Vector3();
  function hitTest(mx,my){
    if(!spawnsOn || !active.length || !camera) return null;
    const kh=khNow(), cp=camera.position;
    let best=null;
    for(const c of active){
      _v.set(c.x,c.y,c.z);
      const dx=c.x-cp.x, dy=c.y-cp.y, dz=c.z-cp.z;
      const d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz);
      if(d<0.5) continue;
      _v.project(camera);
      if(_v.z>1) continue;
      const sx=(_v.x*0.5+0.5)*innerWidth, sy=(-_v.y*0.5+0.5)*innerHeight;
      // must mirror the vertex shader exactly or the click target drifts
      const size=Math.min(Math.max(SPRITE_W, MIN_PX*d/kh), MAX_PX*d/kh)*kh/d;
      if(d > SPRITE_W*kh/FADE_PX) continue;
      if(mx<sx-size*0.5||mx>sx+size*0.5||my<sy-size||my>sy) continue;
      if(!best || d<best.d) best={c:c,d:d};
    }
    if(!best) return null;
    if(blocked(cp.x,cp.y,cp.z, best.c.x,best.c.y,best.c.z)) return null;
    return best.c;
  }

  /* click, but only when the pointer did not travel — the same gesture drags
     the camera, and a 3px slip must not count as a click */
  const cv2=$("scene");
  let downAt=null, travelled=0;
  if(cv2){
    cv2.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{ downAt={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY}; travelled=0; });
    cv2.addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{
      if(downAt) travelled+=Math.abs(e.movementX||0)+Math.abs(e.movementY||0);
      if(e.pointerType==="touch"||downAt) return;
      const c=hitTest(e.clientX,e.clientY);
      showTip(c,e.clientX,e.clientY);
      cv2.style.cursor=c?"pointer":"";
    });
    ["pointerup","pointercancel"].forEach(ev=>cv2.addEventListener(ev,e=>{
      const was=downAt; downAt=null;
      if(!was || travelled>6 || e.type!=="pointerup" || e.button===2) return;
      const c=hitTest(e.clientX,e.clientY);
      if(c) openBestiary(c.n, c.i);
    }));
    cv2.addEventListener("pointerleave",()=>showTip(null));
  }
  const tip=$("spawnTip");
  function showTip(c,mx,my){
    if(!tip) return;
    if(!c){ tip.style.display="none"; return; }
    tip.textContent=M.disp[c.n]+(c.c>1?"  ×"+c.c:"")+"  ·  floor "+gL[c.i];
    tip.style.display="block";
    tip.style.left=Math.min(mx+14, innerWidth-tip.offsetWidth-8)+"px";
    tip.style.top=Math.max(6, my-30)+"px";
  }

  /* ---------------- Settings: on/off + creature filter ---------------- */
  function wireToggle(id,key,get,set){
    const el=$(id);
    if(!el) return;
    el.checked=get();
    el.addEventListener("change",()=>{
      set(el.checked);
      try{ localStorage.setItem(key,el.checked?"1":"0"); }catch(e){}
      showTip(null);
      if(occ&&camera) rebuild();
    });
  }
  wireToggle("spawnOn","apogea_map_spawns",()=>spawnsOn,v=>spawnsOn=v);
  wireToggle("npcOn","apogea_map_npcs",()=>npcOn,v=>npcOn=v);
  function setFilter(idx){
    filterIdx=idx;
    const row=$("spawnFilterRow"), nm=$("spawnFilterName");
    if(row) row.classList.toggle("on", idx>=0);
    if(nm && idx>=0) nm.textContent=M.disp[idx]+" ("+byName[idx].length+")";
    showTip(null);
    if(occ && camera) rebuild();
  }
  const clr=$("spawnFilterClear");
  if(clr) clr.addEventListener("click",()=>setFilter(-1));
  // keyboard route to a creature's card: search it, then press this
  const inf=$("spawnFilterInfo");
  if(inf) inf.addEventListener("click",()=>{
    if(filterIdx>=0) openBestiary(filterIdx, byName[filterIdx][0]);
  });

  /* ---- creatures in the existing finder ----
     Pushing them into NPC_INDEX is all it takes for the box to search them;
     the single __onFindPick hook in go() is what lets a creature pick also set
     the filter. Coordinates are the creature's biggest cluster, so "find
     Skeleton" lands you where the skeletons actually are rather than on some
     lone outlier.

     The entry points at a REAL spawn near the middle of that cluster, never the
     bare centroid: flyToGame() decides whether to slice the floors down by
     testing the column it is sent to, and a centroid can easily land on open
     ground next to the tomb full of skeletons — you would arrive at the right
     place with every creature still sealed under rock. */
  const alreadyListed=new Set(NPC_INDEX.map(e=>e.n));
  const findRep=[];
  for(let k=0;k<M.names.length;k++){
    const list=byName[k];
    findRep.push(-1);
    if(!list.length) continue;
    const cells=new Map();
    for(const i of list){
      const ck=((gX[i]/32)|0)+","+((gZ[i]/32)|0);
      const c=cells.get(ck); if(c) c.push(i); else cells.set(ck,[i]);
    }
    let best=null;
    for(const v of cells.values()) if(!best||v.length>best.length) best=v;
    if(!best) best=list;
    let bx=0,bz=0;
    for(const i of best){ bx+=gX[i]; bz+=gZ[i]; }
    bx/=best.length; bz/=best.length;
    let rep=best[0], bd=Infinity;
    for(const i of best){
      const d=(gX[i]-bx)*(gX[i]-bx)+(gZ[i]-bz)*(gZ[i]-bz);
      if(d<bd){ bd=d; rep=i; }
    }
    findRep[k]=rep;
    /* NPCs are mostly already in NPC_INDEX from the previous extraction — and
       all 195 that overlap have byte-identical coordinates, so there is nothing
       to correct, only the handful the old index never had. Adding the rest
       would just double every NPC in the results list.

       Only creatures carry `c`, so only a creature pick sets the filter:
       "show only King Charles" would blank the map for the sake of one
       character, which is not what searching for him meant. */
    if(alreadyListed.has(M.disp[k])) continue;
    const ent={n:M.disp[k], x:gX[rep], z:gZ[rep], l:gL[rep]};
    if(!isNpc(k)) ent.c=k;
    NPC_INDEX.push(ent);
  }
  window.__onFindPick=function(e){ if(e && e.c!=null) setFilter(e.c); };

  /* ---- fly to a specific spawn, cycling through them on repeat presses ---- */
  const cycle={};
  function flyToCreature(k){
    const list=byName[k]; if(!list.length) return 0;
    const at=(cycle[k]||0)%list.length;
    cycle[k]=at+1;
    const i=list[at];
    flyToGame(gX[i],gZ[i],gL[i]);   // same framing the NPC finder uses
    return at+1;
  }

  /* ---------------- the bestiary card ----------------
     Built from the wiki's own /data files, fetched once on first open, so the
     card here and the card in the Bestiary tab never drift apart: update
     monster_stats.json and both change. */
  let BD=null, bdLoading=null;
  function loadBD(){
    if(BD) return Promise.resolve(BD);
    if(bdLoading) return bdLoading;
    const get=p=>fetch(p).then(r=>r.ok?r.json():null).catch(()=>null);
    bdLoading=Promise.all([
      get("/data/entity_data.json"), get("/data/monster_stats.json"),
      get("/data/monster_images.json"), get("/data/items.json"),
      get("/data/stat_icons.json"), get("/data/entity_aliases.json"),
      get("/data/mob_sprites.json"), get("/data/npc_trade.json")
    ]).then(([ent,stats,imgs,items,sic,alias,mob,trade])=>{
      BD={ent:ent||{},stats:stats||{},imgs:imgs||{},items:items,sic:sic,alias:alias||{},
          mob:mob,trade:trade||{},cellByItem:{}};
      if(items&&items.items) for(const it of items.items){
        BD.cellByItem[it.name.toLowerCase()]=it.cell;
        BD.cellByItem[it.name.replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g,"$1 $2").toLowerCase()]=it.cell;
      }
      return BD;
    });
    return bdLoading;
  }
  const esc=s=>String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]));
  function statIco(name,px){
    if(!BD||!BD.sic||BD.sic.index[name]==null) return "";
    const idx=BD.sic.index[name], cols=BD.sic.cols;
    return '<span class="chip-ico" style="background-image:url(\'/atlas/stat_icons.png\');'+
      'background-position:-'+(idx*px)+'px 0;background-size:'+(cols*px)+'px '+px+'px;'+
      'width:'+px+'px;height:'+px+'px;image-rendering:pixelated;background-repeat:no-repeat;'+
      'display:inline-block;flex:none;vertical-align:middle"></span>';
  }
  function row(ico,label,val){
    return '<div class="k">'+statIco(ico,16)+'<span>'+esc(label)+'</span></div><div class="v">'+esc(val)+'</div>';
  }
  function itemIco(name,px){
    const cell=BD&&BD.cellByItem[String(name||"").toLowerCase()];
    if(cell==null||!BD.items) return '<div class="item-ico" style="width:'+px+'px;height:'+px+'px"></div>';
    const cols=BD.items.cols, cp=BD.items.cell, s=px/cp;
    return '<div class="item-ico" style="width:'+px+'px;height:'+px+'px;'+
      "background-image:url('/atlas/item_atlas.png');background-position:-"+((cell%cols)*cp*s)+
      'px -'+(((cell/cols)|0)*cp*s)+'px;background-size:'+(cols*cp*s)+'px auto"></div>';
  }
  const RAR={common:"Common",semirare:"Semi Rare",rare:"Rare",veryrare:"Very Rare",ultrarare:"Ultra Rare"};
  function pct(c){
    if(c==null||isNaN(c)) return "";
    return ' <span class="loot-pct">('+(Math.round(c*1000)/1000)+'%)</span>';
  }
  function fmtSecs(s){
    if(s==null) return "";
    if(s<60) return s+"s";
    const m=Math.floor(s/60), r=s%60;
    return r? m+"m "+r+"s" : m+"m";
  }
  function fmtWindow(tw){
    if(!tw||(!tw[0]&&!tw[1])) return "All day";
    const p=h=>String(h).padStart(2,"0")+":00";
    return p(tw[0])+" – "+p(tw[1]);
  }
  function spriteStyle(n,px){
    const s=px/M.cell;
    return "background-image:url("+M.atlas+");image-rendering:pixelated;"+
      "background-size:"+(M.aw*s)+"px "+(M.ah*s)+"px;background-repeat:no-repeat;"+
      "background-position:"+(-(n%M.cols)*M.cell*s)+"px "+(-((n/M.cols)|0)*M.cell*s)+"px";
  }

  /* Card artwork, in the wiki's own order of preference: hand-drawn creature
     art where it exists, then the rendered model sheet (which covers every NPC),
     and the minimap sprite as a last resort. */
  function artHTML(n){
    const key=M.names[n], slug=BD.imgs[key];
    if(slug) return '<div class="bd-art" style="background-image:url(\'/monsters/'+esc(slug)+'.png\')"></div>';
    const cell=BD.mob && BD.mob.index && BD.mob.index[key];
    if(cell!=null){
      const cols=BD.mob.cols, cp=BD.mob.cell, px=96, sc=px/cp;
      return '<div class="bd-art" style="width:'+px+'px;height:'+px+'px;'+
        "background-image:url('/atlas/mob_sprites.png');background-position:-"+((cell%cols)*cp*sc)+
        'px -'+(((cell/cols)|0)*cp*sc)+'px;background-size:'+(cols*cp*sc)+'px auto"></div>';
    }
    return '<div class="bd-art" style="'+spriteStyle(n,96)+';background-size:'+
      (M.aw*96/M.cell)+'px '+(M.ah*96/M.cell)+'px"></div>';
  }

  /* Merge the two trade sources the way the wiki does: the extraction is
     authoritative for prices (it IS the game data) and knows shops the hand-kept
     doc never had, while the doc carries the category labels the extraction has
     no idea about. Doc rows first so their order and labels survive, prices
     overwritten, then anything only the extraction knows appended. */
  function spaced(v){ return String(v).replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g,"$1 $2"); }
  function mergedTrade(key, ed){
    const doc=BD.trade[key] || (BD.alias[key] && BD.trade[BD.alias[key].stat]);
    const off={sells:new Map(),buys:new Map()};
    for(const mode of ["sells","buys"])
      for(const r of (ed[mode]||[])){
        const k=String(r.item).toLowerCase();
        if(!off[mode].has(k)) off[mode].set(k,r);
      }
    const out={sells:[],buys:[]}, used={sells:new Set(),buys:new Set()};
    for(const mode of ["sells","buys"]){
      for(const r of ((doc&&doc[mode])||[])){
        // the doc spells items with spaces ("Rat Tail"), the extraction without
        const k=String(r.item).replace(/\s+/g,"").toLowerCase();
        const o=off[mode].get(k);
        if(o){ used[mode].add(k); out[mode].push({item:r.item,price:o.price,category:r.category}); }
        else out[mode].push(r);
      }
      for(const [k,o] of off[mode])
        if(!used[mode].has(k)) out[mode].push({item:spaced(o.item),price:o.price});
    }
    return (out.sells.length||out.buys.length)?out:null;
  }
  // unpriced rows ("??", blank) sort last rather than reading as free
  function priceVal(p){ const n=parseFloat(String(p==null?"":p).replace(/[^\d.]/g,"")); return isFinite(n)?n:Infinity; }
  function tradeHTML(tr){
    function col(list,kind,head){
      if(!list||!list.length) return '<div class="tr-col"><div class="tr-h tr-'+kind+'">'+head+'</div><div class="tr-empty">—</div></div>';
      let h='<div class="tr-col"><div class="tr-h tr-'+kind+'">'+head+'</div>';
      for(const r of list.slice().sort((a,b)=>priceVal(a.price)-priceVal(b.price)||String(a.item).localeCompare(String(b.item)))){
        h+='<div class="tr-row"'+(r.category?' title="'+esc(r.category)+'"':'')+'>'+itemIco(r.item,22)+
           '<span class="tr-nm">'+esc(r.item)+'</span><span class="tr-p">'+
           (r.price==null||r.price===""?"?":esc(r.price))+'</span></div>';
      }
      return h+'</div>';
    }
    return '<div class="bd-sec">Trading</div><div class="tr-grid">'+
      col(tr.sells,"sells","Sells")+col(tr.buys,"buys","Buys")+'</div>';
  }

  const pop=$("mobPop"), body=$("mobBody");
  function popOpen(){ return !!pop && pop.classList.contains("open"); }
  /* Tell the parent page whether a card is up. It owns the fullscreen element,
     so it is the only place that can decide Escape means "close the card" and
     not "leave fullscreen". */
  function tellParent(msg){
    if(window.parent===window) return;
    try{ window.parent.postMessage(msg, location.origin); }catch(e){}
  }
  function closePop(){
    if(!pop) return;
    pop.classList.remove("open");
    tellParent({apogeaMap:"popup",open:false});
  }
  if($("mobClose")) $("mobClose").addEventListener("click",closePop);
  if(pop) pop.addEventListener("click",e=>{ if(e.target===pop) closePop(); });
  addEventListener("message",e=>{
    if(e.origin!==location.origin) return;
    if(e.data && e.data.apogeaMap==="closePopup") closePop();
  });
  /* Escape order: card first, then whatever the page would normally do. The
     capture phase and stopPropagation are what keep the Settings drawer from
     also closing on the same keystroke. */
  document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
    if(e.key!=="Escape" || listening) return;
    if(popOpen()){ e.stopPropagation(); e.preventDefault(); closePop(); return; }
    tellParent({apogeaMap:"esc"});
  },true);

  function openBestiary(n, spawnIdx){
    if(!pop||!body) return;
    showTip(null);
    // the landmark layer borrows this same shell, so the label is set per open
    pop.setAttribute("aria-label","Creature details");
    pop.classList.add("open");
    tellParent({apogeaMap:"popup",open:true});
    body.innerHTML='<div class="bd-loading">LOADING…</div>';
    loadBD().then(()=>render(n,spawnIdx));
  }

  function render(n, spawnIdx){
    const key=M.names[n], pretty=M.disp[n], type=M.types[n];
    const ed=BD.ent[String(type)]||{};
    // monster_stats is keyed by the wiki's display name, with an alias table
    // for the handful whose actor key and stat key differ (MaleGhoul -> Ghoul)
    const statKey=(BD.alias[key]&&BD.alias[key].stat)||pretty;
    const st=BD.stats[statKey]||BD.stats[pretty]||null;
    const s=ed.stats||{};
    const npc=isNpc(n);
    const tr=npc?mergedTrade(key,ed):null;
    const total=byName[n].length;
    const kindLine=npc
      ? "NPC"+(tr?" · Trader":"")
      : (M.boss[n]?"Boss":"Creature")+" · "+total+" spawn"+(total===1?"":"s")+" worldwide";
    let h='<div class="bd-head">'+artHTML(n)+'<div><div class="bd-title">'+esc(pretty)+'</div>'+
      '<div class="bd-cat">'+esc(kindLine)+'</div>'+
      // "Baldwin, the blacksmith" — the game's own one-line description
      (npc&&ed.view?'<div class="bd-view">'+esc(ed.view)+'</div>':'')+'</div></div>';

    if(spawnIdx!=null){
      const doc=BD.trade[key];
      h+='<div class="bd-sec">'+(npc?"Location":"This spawn")+'</div><div class="kv">'+
        (doc&&doc.city?'<div class="k"><span>City</span></div><div class="v">'+esc(doc.city)+'</div>':'')+
        '<div class="k"><span>Coordinates</span></div><div class="v">'+gX[spawnIdx]+', '+gZ[spawnIdx]+'</div>'+
        '<div class="k"><span>Floor</span></div><div class="v">'+gL[spawnIdx]+'</div>'+
        (npc&&total>1?'<div class="k"><span>Also appears</span></div><div class="v">'+(total-1)+' other place'+(total===2?"":"s")+'</div>':'')+
        '</div>';
    }

    let kv="";
    const hp=(st&&st.hp!=null)?st.hp:s.hp;
    const xp=(st&&st.xp!=null)?st.xp:s.xp;
    const dmg=(st&&st.dmg!=null&&st.dmg!==0)?st.dmg:s.dmg;
    const arm=(st&&st.arm!=null&&st.arm!==0)?st.arm:s.arm;
    if(hp!=null)     kv+=row("health","Health",hp);
    if(xp!=null)     kv+=row("experience","Experience",xp);
    if(dmg!=null)    kv+=row("damage","Damage",dmg);
    if(arm!=null)    kv+=row("armor","Armor",arm);
    if(s.def!=null)  kv+=row("defense","Defense",s.def);
    if(s.magic!=null)kv+=row("magic","Magic",s.magic);
    if(s.mp!=null)   kv+=row("mana","Mana",s.mp);
    if(s.ms!=null)   kv+=row("movespeed","Move speed",s.ms);
    if(s.as!=null)   kv+=row("attackspeed","Attack speed",s.as);
    if(s.range!=null)kv+=row("range","Range",s.range);
    if(s.hpreg!=null)kv+=row("hpreg","HP regen",s.hpreg);
    if(s.mpreg!=null)kv+=row("mpreg","MP regen",s.mpreg);
    if(ed.stagger!=null) kv+='<div class="k"><span>Stagger</span></div><div class="v">'+ed.stagger+'%</div>';
    if(ed.respawn!=null){
      const r=Array.isArray(ed.respawn)?ed.respawn:[ed.respawn];
      kv+='<div class="k"><span>Respawn</span></div><div class="v">'+esc(r.map(fmtSecs).join(" – "))+'</div>';
    }
    if(ed.time) kv+='<div class="k"><span>Active</span></div><div class="v">'+esc(fmtWindow(ed.time))+'</div>';
    if(kv) h+='<div class="bd-sec">Stats</div><div class="kv">'+kv+'</div>';

    // loot: the curated table first (it carries rarity tiers the raw extraction
    // only flags as a boolean), the official drops as fallback
    const chanceOf=l=>{ const v=parseFloat(l&&l.chance); return isFinite(v)?v:-Infinity; };
    const byChance=(a,b)=>chanceOf(b)-chanceOf(a)||String(a.item||"").localeCompare(String(b.item||""));
    if(!npc && st&&st.loot&&st.loot.length){
      h+='<div class="bd-sec">Loot</div><div class="loot-list">';
      for(const l of st.loot.slice().sort(byChance)){
        const cnt=(l.count&&l.count!=="1")?" ×"+l.count:"";
        h+='<div class="loot-row" data-rar="'+esc(l.rarity||"common")+'">'+itemIco(l.item,28)+
          '<span class="loot-nm">'+esc(l.item)+cnt+'</span><span class="loot-rar">'+
          (l.chance===0?"No drop":(RAR[l.rarity]||l.rarity||"")+pct(l.chance))+'</span></div>';
      }
      h+='</div>';
    }else if(!npc && ed.drops&&ed.drops.length){
      h+='<div class="bd-sec">Loot</div><div class="loot-list">';
      for(const l of ed.drops.slice().sort(byChance)){
        const disp=String(l.item).replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g,"$1 $2");
        const cnt=l.amount==null?"":(Array.isArray(l.amount)?" ×"+l.amount[0]+"–"+l.amount[1]:" ×"+l.amount);
        h+='<div class="loot-row">'+itemIco(l.item,28)+'<span class="loot-nm">'+esc(disp)+cnt+
          '</span><span class="loot-rar">'+(l.chance!=null?l.chance+"%":"")+'</span></div>';
      }
      h+='</div>';
    }

    if(tr) h+=tradeHTML(tr);

    if(ed.cries&&ed.cries.length){
      h+='<div class="bd-sec">War cries</div>';
      for(const c of ed.cries) h+='<div class="cry-row" title="'+esc(c.chance)+'% chance to say"><span class="cry-q">“</span>'+esc(c.text)+'”</div>';
    }

    h+='<div class="bd-acts">'+
       (total>1?'<button type="button" id="bdNext">Fly to next spawn</button>':'')+
       '<button type="button" id="bdOnly">'+(filterIdx===n?"Show all":"Only this one")+'</button>'+
       '<a href="/atlas/#tab='+(npc?"npcs":"bestiary")+'" target="_top">'+(npc?"NPCs":"Bestiary")+' ↗</a></div>';
    body.innerHTML=h;

    const nx=$("bdNext");
    if(nx) nx.addEventListener("click",()=>{ flyToCreature(n); closePop(); });
    const on=$("bdOnly");
    if(on) on.addEventListener("click",()=>{ setFilter(filterIdx===n?-1:n); closePop(); });
  }

  addEventListener("resize",()=>{ if(occ&&camera) rebuild(); });
  setHint(0);
})();

/* ============================================================
   LANDMARK LAYER — the game's own "tracks"
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   TRACKS is the client's hiddenTrackDict: 150 entries, each with the world
   position the game itself uses and a `symbol` that indexes the game's own
   minimap POI icons (TRACK_ICONS, one 16px cell per symbol). Every one is drawn
   with its icon and its name so you can tell where you are without leaving the
   map to look something up.

   Deliberately NOT a second copy of the spawn layer:

   - No clustering. 150 fixed, uniquely-named points do not pile up the way
     3,838 creature spawns do, so there is nothing to collapse and no count
     badge. That removes the whole rebuild-while-flying problem: a landmark's
     world position never depends on the camera.
   - Therefore this rebuilds ONLY when `cap` or `elev` changes, or the toggle
     flips — not on movement. Billboarding, distance sizing and the fade all
     happen in the vertex shader, so flying costs nothing here.
   - Its own shader, because a label quad is wide and a sprite quad is square:
     aCorner carries each quad's aspect instead of being baked once.

   Occlusion matches the spawn sprites exactly — depthTest against the terrain,
   plus the same surfaceFloorAt() column test that hides anything still buried
   under rock until you slice down to its floor. A landmark inside a mountain
   stays hidden rather than floating over it.
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  if(typeof TRACKS==="undefined" || !TRACKS.length || typeof TRACK_ICONS==="undefined") return;

  /* 8 of the client's 150 tracks are trader one-liners ("Opal, trades
     equipment.", "Burl, trades ale.") rather than places, and those characters
     are already on the NPC layer with hours and a full sells/buys table. They
     are filtered here rather than deleted from TRACKS: the shipped data stays a
     faithful copy of the dump, and only what gets drawn is a judgement. 142 left. */
  const PLACES = TRACKS.filter(t => !/,\s+trades\s/.test(t.t));
  if(!PLACES.length) return;

  /* Icon and label share ONE size (and one clamp), and the label's height is a
     fraction of it. They have to: aOffset is measured in units of the quad's
     own clamped size, so giving the two quads separate clamps would let them
     drift apart as soon as either one hit its floor or ceiling. */
  const ICON_W = 5.0;          // world height of a landmark quad
  const MIN_PX = 16;           // ...floored so a distant name stays readable
  const MAX_PX = 44;           // ...capped so one you fly into cannot fill the view
  const LBL_REL = 0.80;        // label plate height, as a fraction of that
  /* Names stay on at every range by design. FADE_D only dissolves the ones so
     far away their text is sub-pixel anyway — without it the whole-world view
     is 150 overlapping strings. Raise it to label further, lower it to thin
     the view out sooner. */
  const FADE_D = 2400, FADE_W = 700;

  const ICON_CELL = 16, ICON_COLS = 8;
  /* The stack floats name-over-icon, well clear of the ground. Both are
     depth-tested against the terrain, and a wide text plate intersects scenery
     far more readily than a 16px icon does — lifting it above roof height is
     what keeps a name from being sliced in half by the building it belongs to.
     The icon still marks the true spot; the line under the name points at it. */
  const ICON_UP = 1.35;        // how far above the tile the icon floats

  /* ---- grouping ----
     Two places share one tile outright (Nordha Market & Center / Nordha Town
     Center), but that is not what makes the map unreadable: pull back and a
     district's worth of names lands inside the same handful of pixels. Both
     are the same problem at different scales, so one rule covers both —
     anything that would land within GROUP_PX of another marker collapses into
     a single marker with a count badge, and the badge opens the list.

     GROUP_PX is roughly the width of a name plate at its minimum size, which
     is exactly the distance at which two of them start to overlap.

     The grid is the spawn layer's: world-anchored, power-of-two, sized from
     the distance to the COARSE block rather than to the landmark itself. That
     is what keeps a group still while you fly — every member of a block agrees
     on the cell size, so a group can never be torn in half by two of its own
     members rounding to different grids, and the size only changes at discrete
     steps rather than drifting continuously. Cells are never smaller than one
     voxel, so tiles that genuinely coincide stay grouped at every zoom. */
  const GROUP_PX = 48, COARSE = 32, MAX_LVL = 8;
  const REBUILD_MS = 110;      // grouping now depends on the camera; idle rate while flying

  let tracksOn = true;
  try{ tracksOn = localStorage.getItem("apogea_map_tracks") !== "0"; }catch(e){}

  const N = PLACES.length;
  /* Same game->voxel transform as flyToGame(); see the note there. Computed
     once — landmarks do not move. */
  const vX = new Int16Array(N), vZ = new Int16Array(N), vF = new Int16Array(N);
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
    const t = PLACES[i];
    vX[i] = Math.round(X/2 + t.x + GX_OFF);
    vZ[i] = Math.round(Z/2 - t.z + GZ_OFF);
    vF[i] = Math.max(0, Math.min(Y-1, Math.round(t.l||0) + LVL_OFF));
  }

  /* ---------------- shaders ----------------
     Same shape as the spawn layer's, with two differences: aCorner is written
     per quad so a label can be wider than it is tall, and uCut lets the pixel
     -art icons keep a hard alpha cut while the antialiased text does not (a
     0.5 cut eats the edges off drawn glyphs). */
  const TVERT=[
    "attribute vec2 aCorner;","attribute vec2 aOffset;","attribute float aSize;",
    "varying vec2 vUv;","varying float vFade;",
    "uniform float uKh;","uniform float uMinPx;","uniform float uMaxPx;",
    "uniform float uFadeD;","uniform float uFadeW;",
    "void main(){",
    "  vUv = uv;",
    "  vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);",
    "  float d = max(-mv.z, 0.001);",
    "  float size = clamp(aSize, uMinPx*d/uKh, uMaxPx*d/uKh);",
    "  mv.xy += aOffset*size + aCorner*size;",
    "  vFade = 1.0 - smoothstep(uFadeD-uFadeW, uFadeD, d);",
    "  gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv;",
    "}"].join("\n");
  const TFRAG=[
    "uniform sampler2D map;","uniform float uCut;",
    "varying vec2 vUv;","varying float vFade;",
    "void main(){",
    "  vec4 c = texture2D(map, vUv);",
    "  float a = c.a * vFade;",
    "  if(a < uCut) discard;",
    "  gl_FragColor = vec4(c.rgb, a);",
    "  #include <encodings_fragment>",
    "}"].join("\n");

  function mkMat(tex,cut){
    return new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms:{map:{value:tex},uKh:{value:800},uMinPx:{value:MIN_PX},uMaxPx:{value:MAX_PX},
                uFadeD:{value:FADE_D},uFadeW:{value:FADE_W},uCut:{value:cut}},
      vertexShader:TVERT, fragmentShader:TFRAG,
      transparent:true, depthTest:true, depthWrite:false
    });
  }

  // POI icons are the game's own pixel art — nearest magnification, mipmapped down.
  const iconTex=new THREE.Texture();
  iconTex.flipY=false; iconTex.magFilter=THREE.NearestFilter;
  iconTex.minFilter=THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;
  (function(){ const im=new Image(); im.onload=()=>{ iconTex.image=im; iconTex.needsUpdate=true; }; im.src=TRACK_ICONS; })();

  /* ---------------- label atlas ----------------
     Built at runtime rather than shipped: the text is already in PLACES, and
     drawing it here costs ~1.5 MB of canvas instead of a baked image in the
     file. Shelf-packed — each name gets exactly the width it needs, so the
     atlas stays one modest texture rather than 150 padded cells. */
  const LBL_H=34, LBL_PAD=10, ATLAS_W=1024;
  const lblUV=new Float32Array(N*4), lblAspect=new Float32Array(N);
  const labelTex=(function(){
    const meas=document.createElement("canvas").getContext("2d");
    const FONT="700 22px 'Lucida Console',Monaco,monospace";
    meas.font=FONT;
    const w=new Array(N);
    let x=0, rows=1;
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
      w[i]=Math.ceil(meas.measureText(PLACES[i].t).width)+LBL_PAD*2;
      if(w[i]>ATLAS_W) w[i]=ATLAS_W;
      if(x+w[i]>ATLAS_W){ x=0; rows++; }
      x+=w[i];
    }
    const H=rows*LBL_H;
    const c=document.createElement("canvas");
    c.width=ATLAS_W; c.height=H;
    const g=c.getContext("2d");
    g.font=FONT; g.textAlign="center"; g.textBaseline="middle";
    x=0; let y=0;
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
      if(x+w[i]>ATLAS_W){ x=0; y+=LBL_H; }
      const cx=x+w[i]/2, cy=y+LBL_H/2;
      // dark plate so a name stays legible over sand, snow or water
      g.fillStyle="rgba(14,12,9,.72)";
      g.fillRect(x+1,y+3,w[i]-2,LBL_H-6);
      g.fillStyle="rgba(240,165,60,.30)";
      g.fillRect(x+1,y+LBL_H-4,w[i]-2,1);
      g.fillStyle="#f4e3c0";
      g.fillText(PLACES[i].t, cx, cy);
      lblUV[i*4]=x/ATLAS_W; lblUV[i*4+1]=y/H;
      lblUV[i*4+2]=(x+w[i])/ATLAS_W; lblUV[i*4+3]=(y+LBL_H)/H;
      lblAspect[i]=w[i]/LBL_H;
      x+=w[i];
    }
    const t=new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
    t.flipY=false; t.magFilter=THREE.LinearFilter;
    t.minFilter=THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;
    return t;
  })();

  /* ---------------- count badge ----------------
     The pill the spawn clusters wear, drawn again here rather than shared: that
     one lives inside the spawn module's closure, and a small canvas is not
     worth welding the two layers together for. 2..99 plus a "99+" cell; a
     marker holding a single place draws no badge at all.

     Drawn again, but not drawn the same. The spawn layer puts a squat pill in a
     SQUARE cell and stretches it onto a 2:1 quad, and at the 16px a landmark
     icon bottoms out at, that distortion plus a mip chain averaging every cell
     with the transparent margin around it leaves a dark half-transparent smear
     where the number should be. Here the cell is 2:1, the pill fills it to
     within two pixels, and the quad is 2:1 — so minification averages the pill
     with itself and the badge survives it. */
  const BADGE_CW=64, BADGE_CH=32, BADGE_COLS=10;
  /* Half-extents in units of the quad's own size. The height is the name
     plate's height exactly, because that is where the badge goes: flush to the
     right-hand end of the name. Hung off the icon instead it would be 8px tall
     at the size an icon bottoms out at, which is a number nobody can read. */
  const BADGE_H=LBL_REL*0.5, BADGE_W=BADGE_H*2;
  const BADGE_GAP=0.03;               // between the plate and the badge
  const BADGE_PAD=BADGE_W+BADGE_GAP/2;// what a badge adds to a marker's footprint
  const badgeTex=(function(){
    const rows=Math.ceil(99/BADGE_COLS);
    const c=document.createElement("canvas");
    c.width=BADGE_COLS*BADGE_CW; c.height=rows*BADGE_CH;
    const g=c.getContext("2d");
    g.textAlign="center"; g.textBaseline="middle";
    for(let n=2;n<=100;n++){
      const i=n-2, x=(i%BADGE_COLS)*BADGE_CW, y=((i/BADGE_COLS)|0)*BADGE_CH;
      const label=n>99?"99+":String(n);
      const w=BADGE_CW-4, h=BADGE_CH-4, r=h/2;
      const px=x+2, py=y+2;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(px+r,py);
      g.arcTo(px+w,py,px+w,py+h,r); g.arcTo(px+w,py+h,px,py+h,r);
      g.arcTo(px,py+h,px,py,r);     g.arcTo(px,py,px+w,py,r);
      g.closePath();
      g.fillStyle="#f0a53c"; g.fill();
      g.lineWidth=3; g.strokeStyle="rgba(0,0,0,.8)"; g.stroke();
      g.fillStyle="#241605";
      g.font="700 "+(label.length>2?17:22)+"px 'Lucida Console',Monaco,monospace";
      g.fillText(label, x+BADGE_CW/2, y+BADGE_CH/2+1);
    }
    const t=new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
    t.flipY=false; t.magFilter=THREE.LinearFilter;
    t.minFilter=THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;
    return t;
  })();

  /* ---------------- quad buffers ---------------- */
  function mkMesh(mat){
    const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    const pos=new Float32Array(N*4*3), cor=new Float32Array(N*4*2),
          uv=new Float32Array(N*4*2), sz=new Float32Array(N*4),
          off=new Float32Array(N*4*2);
    const idx=new Uint16Array(N*6);
    for(let q=0;q<N;q++){
      const b=q*4;
      idx[q*6]=b; idx[q*6+1]=b+1; idx[q*6+2]=b+2;
      idx[q*6+3]=b; idx[q*6+4]=b+2; idx[q*6+5]=b+3;
    }
    g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos,3));
    g.setAttribute("aCorner",  new THREE.BufferAttribute(cor,2));
    g.setAttribute("uv",       new THREE.BufferAttribute(uv,2));
    g.setAttribute("aSize",    new THREE.BufferAttribute(sz,1));
    g.setAttribute("aOffset",  new THREE.BufferAttribute(off,2));
    g.setIndex(new THREE.BufferAttribute(idx,1));
    g.setDrawRange(0,0);
    const m=new THREE.Mesh(g,mat);
    m.frustumCulled=false;
    m.renderOrder=11;              // after the terrain and the spawn sprites
    return m;
  }
  const iconMesh=mkMesh(mkMat(iconTex,0.5));
  const lblMesh =mkMesh(mkMat(labelTex,0.02));
  const badgeMesh=mkMesh(mkMat(badgeTex,0.02));
  badgeMesh.renderOrder=12;        // the badge sits on top of the icon it counts
  let added=false;

  // corner order matches the index buffer: bl, br, tr, tl
  function put(mesh,q,x,y,z,u0,v0,u1,v1,size,halfW,halfH,offy,offx){
    const a=mesh.geometry.attributes;
    const C=[-halfW,-halfH, halfW,-halfH, halfW,halfH, -halfW,halfH];
    for(let v=0;v<4;v++){
      const p=q*4+v;
      a.position.array[p*3]=x; a.position.array[p*3+1]=y; a.position.array[p*3+2]=z;
      a.aCorner.array[p*2]=C[v*2]; a.aCorner.array[p*2+1]=C[v*2+1];
      a.aSize.array[p]=size;
      a.aOffset.array[p*2]=offx||0; a.aOffset.array[p*2+1]=offy;
    }
    // flipY is off on both textures, so v0 is the TOP of the cell
    const U=a.uv.array, b=q*4*2;
    U[b]=u0;   U[b+1]=v1;
    U[b+2]=u1; U[b+3]=v1;
    U[b+4]=u1; U[b+5]=v0;
    U[b+6]=u0; U[b+7]=v0;
  }

  /* Topmost solid floor in each landmark's column at the current slice. Cached
     rather than recomputed inline, because grouping made rebuild() run while
     the camera moves and these are 142 column walks. */
  const surfArr=new Int16Array(N);
  let surfCap=-1;
  function refreshSurf(){
    if(surfCap===cap) return;
    surfCap=cap;
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++) surfArr[i]=surfaceFloorAt(vX[i],vZ[i],cap);
  }
  function khNow(){ return innerHeight*0.5/Math.tan(camera.fov*Math.PI/360); }

  /* Where a marker's NAME PLATE lands on screen, in pixels. This has to mirror
     the vertex shader exactly — the same clamp, the same offsets — because it
     is what decides both what overlaps what and what a click can reach. Null
     means the plate is behind the camera or already faded to nothing. */
  const _v=new THREE.Vector3();
  function plateOf(g,kh,cp){
    const dx=g.x-cp.x, dy=g.y-cp.y, dz=g.z-cp.z;
    const d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz);
    if(d<0.001 || d>=FADE_D) return null;
    _v.set(g.x,g.y,g.z).project(camera);
    if(_v.z>1) return null;
    const sz=Math.min(Math.max(ICON_W, MIN_PX*d/kh), MAX_PX*d/kh);  // world units, the shader's clamp
    const px=sz*kh/d;                                               // ...the same quad, in pixels
    const sx=(_v.x*0.5+0.5)*innerWidth, sy=(-_v.y*0.5+0.5)*innerHeight;
    /* The rectangle covers the name plate AND the room a count badge takes on
       its right — reserved for every marker whether it ends up with one or not,
       because this pass is what decides that. Slightly conservative, and in
       exchange a badge can never land on top of the next name along. */
    return {sx:sx, sy:sy, px:px, sz:sz, d:d,
            cx:sx + BADGE_PAD*px,
            cy:sy-(ICON_UP+0.5+LBL_REL*0.5+0.04)*px,
            hw:LBL_REL*lblAspect[g.i]*0.5*px + BADGE_PAD*px,
            hh:LBL_REL*0.5*px};
  }

  let active=[];                       // the groups as drawn, for hit-testing
  const groups=new Map();
  let lastCap=-1, lastElev=-1, lastOn=null, lastKh=-1, shownCount=0;
  let lastX=1e9, lastY=1e9, lastZ=1e9, lastAt=0;

  function rebuild(){
    const cp=camera.position, kh=khNow();
    lastCap=cap; lastElev=elev; lastOn=tracksOn; lastKh=kh;
    lastX=cp.x; lastY=cp.y; lastZ=cp.z; lastAt=performance.now();

    if(!tracksOn){
      active=[]; shownCount=0;
      for(const m of [iconMesh,lblMesh,badgeMesh]) m.geometry.setDrawRange(0,0);
      setHint(); return;
    }

    refreshSurf();
    groups.clear();
    let shown=0;
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
      const surf=surfArr[i];
      if(surf > vF[i]+1) continue;          // still under rock at this slice
      shown++;
      const wx=vX[i]+0.5, wz=vZ[i]+0.5;
      const wy=(Math.max(surf, vF[i]-1)+1)*elev + 0.25;
      /* Cell size comes from the distance to the COARSE block this landmark
         sits in, not from its own distance: everything in a block then agrees
         on the size, so a group can never be torn in half by two of its members
         rounding to different grids. Powers of two mean the size only changes
         at discrete steps, which is what keeps a group still while you fly. */
      const bx=(Math.floor(vX[i]/COARSE)+0.5)*COARSE, bz=(Math.floor(vZ[i]/COARSE)+0.5)*COARSE;
      const dy=wy-cp.y;
      const bd=Math.sqrt((bx-cp.x)*(bx-cp.x)+dy*dy+(bz-cp.z)*(bz-cp.z));
      let lvl=Math.ceil(Math.log(Math.max(1,GROUP_PX*bd/kh))/Math.LN2);
      if(lvl<0) lvl=0; else if(lvl>MAX_LVL) lvl=MAX_LVL;
      const cs=1<<lvl;
      /* Floors are banded rather than exact, as the spawn layer does it: a
         slice can leave a cave and the town above it both drawn, and a marker
         standing on one must not claim the other twenty floors up. */
      const key=(vF[i]>>2)+"|"+lvl+"|"+Math.floor(vX[i]/cs)+"|"+Math.floor(vZ[i]/cs);
      const g=groups.get(key);
      /* PLACES is alphabetical and this loop ascends, so the first member of a
         group is its lowest index — a fixed choice per group rather than one
         that depends on the camera. The marker therefore cannot creep as you
         fly past, and unlike a centroid it always stands on a real tile. */
      if(!g) groups.set(key,{i:i, m:[i], x:wx, y:wy, z:wz, d2:0});
      else g.m.push(i);
    }
    shownCount=shown;

    /* ---- and then the pass that actually clears the map ----
       A grid cannot see across its own boundaries: two landmarks a single voxel
       apart can fall in different cells and still land on top of each other on
       screen. By this point there are only a few dozen groups left, so a
       straight sweep over their real name plates is affordable and exact — and
       exact is the point, since an overlap the eye can see is the whole
       complaint. Groups are visited in member order, never in camera order, so
       what merges depends only on where things are and not on the order the
       map happened to build them. */
    const list=[...groups.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.i-b.i);
    const kept=[];
    for(const g of list){
      g.r=plateOf(g,kh,cp);
      let host=null;
      if(g.r) for(const k of kept){
        if(!k.r) continue;
        if(Math.abs(g.r.cx-k.r.cx) <= g.r.hw+k.r.hw &&
           Math.abs(g.r.cy-k.r.cy) <= g.r.hh+k.r.hh){ host=k; break; }
      }
      // the host keeps its own name and icon; it only gains members and a badge
      if(host){ for(const m of g.m) host.m.push(m); host.m.sort((a,b)=>a-b); }
      else kept.push(g);
    }

    for(const g of kept){
      const dx=g.x-cp.x, dy=g.y-cp.y, dz=g.z-cp.z;
      g.d2=dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz;
    }
    kept.sort((a,b)=>b.d2-a.d2);          // back to front, so plates blend in order

    const aw=ICON_COLS*ICON_CELL, ah=iconTex.image?iconTex.image.height:aw;
    const bw=BADGE_COLS*BADGE_CW, bh=badgeTex.image.height;
    let nb=0;
    for(let q=0;q<kept.length;q++){
      const g=kept[q], i=g.i, s=PLACES[i].s|0;
      const u0=(s%ICON_COLS)*ICON_CELL, v0=((s/ICON_COLS)|0)*ICON_CELL;
      /* name above icon, icon above the tile — both offsets in units of the
         same clamped size, so the pair never separates at any distance */
      put(iconMesh,q,g.x,g.y,g.z, u0/aw, v0/ah, (u0+ICON_CELL)/aw, (v0+ICON_CELL)/ah,
          ICON_W, 0.5, 0.5, ICON_UP);   // the icon marks the actual tile
      put(lblMesh ,q,g.x,g.y,g.z, lblUV[i*4], lblUV[i*4+1], lblUV[i*4+2], lblUV[i*4+3],
          ICON_W, LBL_REL*lblAspect[i]*0.5, LBL_REL*0.5, ICON_UP+0.5+LBL_REL*0.5+0.04);
      /* A group keeps its first member's own POI icon and name rather than a
         generic folder glyph: the map stays readable at a glance, and the badge
         is what says there is more here than the one name. */
      if(g.m.length>1){
        const bi=Math.min(g.m.length,100)-2;
        const bc=bi%BADGE_COLS, br=(bi/BADGE_COLS)|0;
        /* Flush to the right-hand end of the NAME, and never below it. Every
           quad here is depth-tested at its anchor's depth, so what decides
           whether it survives is the terrain under the PIXELS it covers — and
           from a low camera the ground a few pixels further down the screen is
           much nearer than the tile itself. A badge hung off the icon's bottom
           corner drew its 30 triangles and not one pixel for exactly that
           reason. At the name's height it clears the rooftops the name clears. */
        put(badgeMesh,nb++,g.x,g.y,g.z,
            bc*BADGE_CW/bw, br*BADGE_CH/bh, (bc+1)*BADGE_CW/bw, (br+1)*BADGE_CH/bh,
            ICON_W, BADGE_W, BADGE_H, ICON_UP+0.5+LBL_REL*0.5+0.04,
            LBL_REL*lblAspect[i]*0.5 + BADGE_GAP + BADGE_W);
      }
    }
    for(const m of [iconMesh,lblMesh,badgeMesh]){
      const a=m.geometry.attributes;
      a.position.needsUpdate=a.aCorner.needsUpdate=a.uv.needsUpdate=
        a.aSize.needsUpdate=a.aOffset.needsUpdate=true;
    }
    iconMesh.geometry.setDrawRange(0,kept.length*6);
    lblMesh.geometry.setDrawRange(0,kept.length*6);
    badgeMesh.geometry.setDrawRange(0,nb*6);
    active=kept;
    setHint();
  }

  function tick(){
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    if(!occ || !camera || !scene) return;
    if(!added){ scene.add(iconMesh); scene.add(lblMesh); scene.add(badgeMesh); added=true; }
    const k=khNow();
    iconMesh.material.uniforms.uKh.value=k;
    lblMesh.material.uniforms.uKh.value=k;
    badgeMesh.material.uniforms.uKh.value=k;
    /* Billboarding, sizing and the fade are all in the shader, so nothing has
       to run per frame to keep a marker welded to its tile. Only the GROUPING
       depends on where the camera is, and a group's world position never moves
       between rebuilds — so this can idle at ~9Hz while flying without any of
       the markers lagging behind the terrain. */
    const cp=camera.position;
    const moved=Math.abs(cp.x-lastX)+Math.abs(cp.y-lastY)+Math.abs(cp.z-lastZ);
    if(cap!==lastCap || elev!==lastElev || tracksOn!==lastOn || k!==lastKh
       || (moved>3 && performance.now()-lastAt>REBUILD_MS)) rebuild();
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);

  function setHint(){
    const h=$("trackHint");
    if(!h) return;
    const marks=active.length;
    /* "at this floor" is dropped once there is a marker count to show — the
       two together wrap the panel onto a second line. */
    h.textContent = !tracksOn ? "Hidden"
      : marks && marks<shownCount
        ? (shownCount===N ? N+" places" : shownCount+" of "+N+" places")+" · "+marks+" markers"
        : (shownCount===N ? N+" places" : shownCount+" of "+N+" places at this floor");
    h.classList.toggle("on", tracksOn);
  }

  /* ---------------- picking ----------------
     The depth buffer decides what is DRAWN, so the click test has to reach the
     same verdict on its own. A quad's DEPTH is its anchor's — the shader only
     ever shifts x and y — so marching the voxel field from the camera to the
     tile is the matching test. It runs only for whatever is under the cursor. */
  function blocked(ax,ay,az,bx,by,bz){
    const dx=bx-ax, dy=by-ay, dz=bz-az;
    const dist=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz);
    if(dist<3) return false;
    const n=Math.min(600, Math.ceil(dist));
    const sx=dx/n, sy=dy/n/elev, sz=dz/n;     // Y is scaled by elev in world space
    let x=ax, y=ay/elev, z=az;
    for(let i=0;i<n-2;i++){                   // stop short of the marker's own ground
      x+=sx; y+=sy; z+=sz;
      const cx=x|0, cz=z|0, fl=Math.floor(y);
      if(cx<0||cx>=X||cz<0||cz>=Z||fl<0||fl>Y-1||fl>cap) continue;
      if(occ[fl*X*Z + cz*X + cx]) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  function hitTest(mx,my){
    if(!tracksOn || !active.length || !camera) return null;
    const kh=khNow(), cp=camera.position;
    let best=null;
    for(const g of active){
      // recomputed rather than reused from the rebuild: that one can be up to
      // REBUILD_MS old, and a click has to land where the marker is drawn NOW
      const r=plateOf(g,kh,cp);
      if(!r || r.d<0.5) continue;             // faded out is not clickable
      // the icon, then the much wider name plate above it — either one counts
      const ich=0.5*r.px, icy=r.sy-ICON_UP*r.px;
      if(!((Math.abs(mx-r.sx)<=ich  && Math.abs(my-icy)<=ich) ||
           (Math.abs(mx-r.cx)<=r.hw && Math.abs(my-r.cy)<=r.hh))) continue;
      if(!best || r.d<best.d) best={g:g,r:r};
    }
    if(!best) return null;
    /* March to the PLATE, not to the tile. The whole point of floating a name
       above roof height is that you can read it when the place itself is round
       the back of a building — testing the tile would refuse the click on a
       name that is plainly there. A place genuinely sealed inside a mountain
       has its plate buried too, so that case still refuses. */
    const up=(ICON_UP+0.5+LBL_REL*0.5+0.04)*best.r.sz;
    if(blocked(cp.x,cp.y,cp.z, best.g.x,best.g.y+up,best.g.z)) return null;
    return best.g;
  }

  /* ---------------- tooltip, click, the folder itself ---------------- */
  const cv=$("scene"), tip=$("lmTip"), pop=$("mobPop"), popBody=$("mobBody");
  const esc=s=>String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]));
  // one rule, not one data: URL per row — the atlas is 6.7 KB of base64
  (function(){
    const st=document.createElement("style");
    st.textContent=".lm-ico{background-image:url("+TRACK_ICONS+")}";
    document.head.appendChild(st);
  })();
  function tellParent(msg){
    if(window.parent===window) return;
    try{ window.parent.postMessage(msg, location.origin); }catch(e){}
  }
  function showTip(g,mx,my){
    if(!tip) return;
    if(!g){ tip.style.display="none"; return; }
    const n=g.m.length, t=PLACES[g.i];
    tip.textContent = n>1
      ? n+" places here  ·  click to list them"
      : t.t+"  ·  floor "+t.l+"  ·  click to fly here";
    tip.style.display="block";
    tip.style.left=Math.min(mx+14, innerWidth-tip.offsetWidth-8)+"px";
    tip.style.top=Math.max(6, my-30)+"px";
  }
  function openFolder(g){
    if(!pop||!popBody) return;
    showTip(null);
    let h='<div class="lm-head">'+g.m.length+' places here</div>'+
          '<div class="lm-sub">Same spot on the map &middot; pick one to fly to it</div>';
    for(const i of g.m){
      const t=PLACES[i], col=(t.s|0)%ICON_COLS, row=((t.s|0)/ICON_COLS)|0;
      h+='<button type="button" class="lm-row" data-i="'+i+'">'+
         '<span class="lm-ico" style="background-position:'+(-col*32)+'px '+(-row*32)+'px"></span>'+
         '<span class="lm-nm">'+esc(t.t)+'</span>'+
         '<span class="lm-fl">FLOOR '+t.l+'</span></button>';
    }
    popBody.innerHTML=h;
    for(const b of popBody.querySelectorAll(".lm-row")){
      b.addEventListener("click",()=>{
        const t=PLACES[+b.dataset.i];
        pop.classList.remove("open");
        tellParent({apogeaMap:"popup",open:false});
        flyToGame(t.x, t.z, t.l);
      });
    }
    pop.setAttribute("aria-label","Places at this spot");
    pop.classList.add("open");
    tellParent({apogeaMap:"popup",open:true});
  }
  if(cv){
    /* click, but only when the pointer did not travel — the same gesture drags
       the camera, and a 3px slip must not count as a click */
    let downAt=null, travelled=0;
    cv.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{ downAt={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY}; travelled=0; });
    cv.addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{
      if(downAt) travelled+=Math.abs(e.movementX||0)+Math.abs(e.movementY||0);
      if(e.pointerType==="touch"||downAt) return;
      const g=hitTest(e.clientX,e.clientY);
      showTip(g,e.clientX,e.clientY);
      /* Only ever UPGRADE the cursor. The spawn layer's handler is registered
         first and resets it on every move, so clearing it here would wipe out
         its hit whenever a creature and a landmark are both in view. */
      if(g) cv.style.cursor="pointer";
    });
    ["pointerup","pointercancel"].forEach(ev=>cv.addEventListener(ev,e=>{
      const was=downAt; downAt=null;
      if(!was || travelled>6 || e.type!=="pointerup" || e.button===2) return;
      // a creature card on this same click wins: it opened first, on this event
      if(pop && pop.classList.contains("open")) return;
      const g=hitTest(e.clientX,e.clientY);
      if(!g) return;
      if(g.m.length>1) openFolder(g);
      else{ showTip(null); const t=PLACES[g.i]; flyToGame(t.x, t.z, t.l); }
    }));
    cv.addEventListener("pointerleave",()=>showTip(null));
  }

  const el=$("trackOn");
  if(el){
    el.checked=tracksOn;
    el.addEventListener("change",()=>{
      tracksOn=el.checked;
      try{ localStorage.setItem("apogea_map_tracks", tracksOn?"1":"0"); }catch(e){}
      if(occ&&camera) rebuild();
    });
  }

  /* ---- places in the existing finder ----
     Same rule the NPC entries follow: only push a name the box does not already
     have, so nothing appears twice. "Blacksmith Brean" is both a character and a
     place, and the character's entry already covers that spot. */
  if(typeof NPC_INDEX!=="undefined"){
    const have=new Set(NPC_INDEX.map(e=>e.n));
    for(const t of PLACES){
      if(have.has(t.t)) continue;
      have.add(t.t);
      NPC_INDEX.push({n:t.t, x:t.x, z:t.z, l:t.l});
    }
    NPC_INDEX.sort((a,b)=>a.n.localeCompare(b.n));
  }

  setHint();
})();

init();
</script>
</body>
</html>
